# JSON mode contract: every command ends in exactly one terminal event
# (result, plan, or error) and never prints free-form text on stdout.

exec orbiter galaxy add test-corp

# --- errors are events on stdout; exit is non-zero; stderr stays empty ---
! exec orbiter --output json survey nonexistent
stdout '^\{"type":"error","txn":"[0-9a-z]{16}","data":\{"message":"[^"]*not found'
! stderr .

# --- build commands return the entity they registered or initialized ---
exec orbiter --output json galaxy add acme
stdout '^\{"type":"result","txn":"[0-9a-z]{16}","data":\{"success":true,"message":"[^"]*","data":\{"type":"galaxy","id":"[0-9a-z]{16}","name":"acme"\}\}\}$'
! stdout '^[^{]'   # no free-form text, only event lines

exec orbiter --output json system add platform --galaxy acme
stdout '"type":"system".*"name":"platform".*"galaxy":"acme"'

exec orbiter --output json planet add api --galaxy acme --system platform
stdout '"type":"planet".*"name":"api".*"galaxy":"acme".*"system":"platform"'

exec orbiter --output json callsign add work
stdout '"type":"callsign".*"name":"work"'

exec orbiter --output json transponder add gh --role env --brand github --location GH_TOKEN
stdout '"type":"transponder".*"name":"gh".*"role":"env".*"brand":"github"'

exec orbiter --output json resource add go --role runtime --brand go
stdout '"type":"resource".*"name":"go".*"role":"runtime".*"brand":"go"'

exec orbiter --output json attach go api
stdout '"from":"go".*"to":"api"'
stdout '"id":"[0-9a-z]{16}"'
! stdout '^[^{]'

exec orbiter --output json galaxy init beta
stdout '"type":"galaxy".*"name":"beta".*"status":"[a-z]+"'

exec orbiter --output json system init ops --galaxy acme
stdout '"type":"system".*"name":"ops".*"status":"[a-z]+"'

exec orbiter --output json planet init web --galaxy acme
stdout '"type":"planet".*"name":"web".*"status":"[a-z]+"'

exec orbiter --output json callsign init work2
stdout '"type":"callsign".*"name":"work2".*"status":"[a-z]+"'

exec orbiter --output json resource init node --role runtime --brand node
stdout '"type":"resource".*"name":"node".*"status":"[a-z]+"'

exec orbiter --output json transponder init gh2 --role env --brand github --location GH_TOKEN
stdout '"type":"transponder".*"name":"gh2".*"status":"[a-z]+"'

# --- lifecycle commands ---
exec orbiter --output json scan api
stdout '^\{"type":"result",.*"target":"api".*"items":\[.*"kind":"resource".*"role":"runtime","brand":"go","status":"failed","report":\{'
! stdout '^[^{]'

exec orbiter --output json scan work
stdout '"target":"work".*"items":\['

exec orbiter --output json scan web
stdout '"target":"web".*"items":\[\]'

exec orbiter --output json calibrate api
stdout '^\{"type":"result",.*"target":"api".*"items":\[.*"kind":"resource".*"role":"runtime","brand":"go","action":"failed","before":\{.*"after":\{'
! stdout '^[^{]'

# chart always ends in a plan event, even when there is nothing to chart
exec orbiter --output json chart api
stdout '^\{"type":"plan","txn":"[0-9a-z]{16}","data":\[\{"action"'
exec orbiter --output json chart web
stdout '^\{"type":"plan","txn":"[0-9a-z]{16}","data":\[\]\}$'

# retro (-y: JSON clients cannot answer the terminal prompt)
exec orbiter --output json retro web -y
stdout '^\{"type":"result",.*"target":"web","retired":true,"nodes":\[\{"name":"web","action":"[a-z]+"\}'
exec orbiter --output json retro ops -y
stdout '"target":"ops","retired":true'
